    Chocolate
    Class for the non-moving enemy type Chocolate
    Doug
    Represents the main character, Doug, in the game.

    The EnemyType enum defines different types of enemies in the game.
    Exit
    Represents the Exit object in the game.
    Game
    The Game class manages the main game loop and window.
    GameConfig
     
    GameObject
    The GameObject class is an abstract class representing all objects in the game.
    GameOverScreen
    The GameOverScreen class displays a "GAME OVER" message and listens for "Enter" to restart the game from the beginning.
    GenerationConfig
     
    Handler
    The Handler class is responsible for managing all game objects in the game.
    Health
    The Health class manages the player's health in the game.
    ID
    The ID enum defines the different types of game objects.
    ImageLoader
    Utility class for loading and scaling images
    KeyInput
    Handles keyboard input for the game.
    MainMenu
    The MainMenu class displays the game's main menu and handles input to start the game or view instructions.
    MovingEnemy
    The MovingEnemy class represents enemies that move and apply penalties to the player.
    Mushroom
    Represents a Mushroom reward in the game.
    Obstacle
    The Obstacle class represents an obstacle in the game that blocks movement.
    ObstacleType
    The ObstacleType enum defines different types of obstacles in the game.
    Onion
     
    Punishment
    The Punishment class represents a type of enemy that applies a specific punishment to the player.
    PunishmentType
    The PunishmentType enum defines different types of punishments that can be applied to the player.
    Rat
    Class for the moving enemy type Rat
    Reward
    The Reward class represents a type of object that applies a specific reward to the player.
    RewardType
    The RewardType enum defines different types of rewards that can be applied to the player.
    Score
    The Score class manages the player's score and displays it on the screen.
    SoundEffect
     
    Steak
    Represents a Steak reward in the game.
    Whiskey
     
    Window
    The Window class is responsible for creating the main game window.
    WinningScreen
    The WinningScreen class displays a congratulatory message when the player completes the game phase.
